title: pouteria fabrilis
intro: Pouteria fabrilis, commonly known as the Brazilian cherry or cabruca, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapotaceae. It is a medium-sized tree native to the tropical regions of Central and South America, valued for its timber, edible fruit, and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Pouteria fabrilis include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Pouteria fabrilis include tannins, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
